mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals a weakening demand environment, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS declines for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth < 2% YoY) coupled with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals accommodative monetary conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY growth is < 2% and FEDFUNDS is < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a single month, coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS declines by more than 100,000 and UNRATE increases by more than 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a single month signals a weakening supply side, leading to reduced economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO declines by more than 2% in a month.
